query: UPDATE builds SET source_commit=?1,image_reference=?2,image_digest=?3,updated_at_ms=?4 WHERE id=?5 AND state='running' AND (source_commit IS NULL OR source_commit=?1) AND (image_reference IS NULL OR image_reference=?2) AND (image_digest IS NULL OR image_digest=?3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operations WHERE id=builds.operation_id AND state='running')
